title: Letters of the Alphabet (A-H)
subject: English Language
objectives: Recognize the letters A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H

blocks.md:
The alphabet starts with these letters:

- **Aa** (An apple)
- **Bb** (A ball)
- **Cc** (A cat)
- **Dd** (A dog)
- **Ee** (An egg)
- **Ff** (A flower)
- **Gg** (A goat)
- **Hh** (A house)
**Practice:** Say the letters out loud: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.

quiz.explain: The alphabet goes A, B, C...
Cat starts with the letter C.
